maria (mlinfra): Ran regional KV paging sensitivity with a mixed seqlen trace (short=64:40%, mid=256:30%, long=1024:30%) across h100/us-west1 and a100/eu-west1. Observed p99 spike on h100/us-west1 when miss rate > 18% — p99 jumped 42ms -> 110ms. Full CSV + raw logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/1802345678/results.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:

bench-bot: uploaded csv + latency hist + per-slen hitrate + eviction logs. summary line: h100 us-west1 miss=22% p50=28ms p99=110ms; a100 eu-west1 miss=9% p50=24ms p99=65ms. See /files/1802345678/*.json

ajay (perf): did you run CLOCK vs LRU on the h100? and which attention kernel was used?

maria (mlinfra): h100 run used LRU (default), kernel=attn_v1 (fused off). a100 run used CLOCK + attn_fused. Forcing CLOCK on h100 dropped p99 to ~78ms but throughput down ~8%.

noah (runtime): sounds like paging slosh. what's the per-shard cache size and page_size? any IO stall patterns?

maria (mlinfra): cache_size=12GB per model shard, page_size=512KB, prefetch=false, eviction_sweep_interval=15s. eviction sweep correlates with IO spikes in the logs. snippet:
```
# /etc/redwood/bench.conf
cache_size=12GB
page_size=512KB
eviction_policy=LRU
prefetch=false
```

ciara (eng-ml): @maria can you try prefetch=true + smaller page_size=256KB? also try kernel `attn_fused_v2` on h100 — reduces memcpy overhead for short sequences.

maria (mlinfra): starting that now. quick aside: quantizing to 4bit changes kernel fallback to `int4_attn` which reduced memory pressure in a short run. 4bit + CLOCK + prefetch -> miss 11% p99=58ms (short run).

ajay (perf): interesting. keep an eye on quality regressions if you push 4bit — run the eval harness.

maria (mlinfra): ran a lightweight eval on 1k prompts: quality delta ~0.4% (within noise). scheduling full eval on 10k next.

bench-bot: new run started (run_id=1802345699): mix trace, h100/us-west1, cache=12GB, page=256KB, eviction=CLOCK, prefetch=true, kernel=attn_fused_v2, quant=4bit. logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/1802345699/

noah (runtime): :thumbsup: can you also capture GPU counters (L2_miss, sm_efficiency) and host page fault stats?

maria (mlinfra): adding `--profiling kernels,caches,host_pages` to the runner. ETA ~45m.

elsa (prodops): we should also vary shard sizes on Dedicated pools — fragmentation might make eviction worse for certain rack layouts.

ciara (eng-ml): agree. I'll schedule a follow-up: region stripe test with shard sizes [8GB,12GB,16GB] + the mixed trace across us-west1/eu-west1.

maria (mlinfra): short takeaway so far: kernel choice + eviction policy + quantization interact nonlinearly. on h100: prefer `attn_fused_v2` + CLOCK + prefetch + int4 (if eval holds). on a100: LRU + 8bit remains stable at current sizing. will share full charts once run completes. :rocket:

bench-bot: uploaded chart pack: https://internal.redwood/bench/1802345678/charts.tar.gz
